note: Five CAB-Lite records copied unchanged from data/cab_lite/cab_lite.json (commit f4674bf). The run reads only 'Rawdata Context' (the sensory context, already text: a Qwen2-VL summary of the egocentric frames plus the audio transcription) and 'Personas' (the persona supplied with the sample), as get_contextual_info and run_single_sample in src/icl/inference_api.py do. The annotated fields (Thoughts, Tools, Response, ...) are kept for analysis and are never sent to a model. Chosen so that the A->S site is exercised: each annotated chain gathers context (GPS, route, weather, date, agenda) whose sandbox values fit the scene, and in a probe the backbone planned information-gathering calls for each (it abstained on records without an explicit need in the conversation, e.g. example-3, -6, -220, -122).
